definition: likely to do something or suffer from something bad (prone to + something/-ing)
exampleSentence: Some plants are very prone to disease.
exampleTranslation: Một số loại cây rất dễ mắc bệnh.

definition: wanting to protect someone from harm or danger (protective of + somebody/something)
exampleSentence: He is very protective of his younger brother.
exampleTranslation: Anh ấy rất che chở cho em trai.

definition: having the knowledge or skills needed for something (qualified for + something)
translation: đủ điều kiện, đủ năng lực cho
exampleSentence: Dawn is well qualified for her new role.
exampleTranslation: Dawn hoàn toàn đủ năng lực cho vai trò mới.

definition: dependent on someone or something (reliant on + somebody/something)
exampleSentence: Most companies are now reliant on computer technology.
exampleTranslation: Hầu hết các công ty hiện đều phụ thuộc vào công nghệ máy tính.

definition: very different from something, or far away from it (remote from + something)
exampleSentence: The village was quiet and remote from city life.
exampleTranslation: Ngôi làng yên tĩnh và cách biệt với cuộc sống thành thị.

definition: not damaged or affected by something (resistant to + something)
exampleSentence: This is an infection that is resistant to antibiotics.
exampleTranslation: Đây là một ca nhiễm trùng kháng kháng sinh.

definition: containing a lot of something (rich in + something)
exampleSentence: Citrus fruits are rich in vitamin C.
exampleTranslation: Trái cây họ cam quýt giàu vitamin C.

definition: not happy, especially because something unpleasant has happened (sad about + something)
exampleSentence: I was sad about the friends I was leaving behind.
exampleTranslation: Tôi buồn vì phải bỏ lại những người bạn.

definition: able to understand other people's feelings, or easily affected by something (sensitive to + something/somebody)
exampleSentence: It has made me more sensitive to the needs of disabled people.
exampleTranslation: Điều đó khiến tôi nhạy cảm hơn với nhu cầu của người khuyết tật.

definition: not related to or not affected by something else (separate from + something)
exampleSentence: He tries to keep his work life separate from his private life.
exampleTranslation: Anh ấy cố giữ cuộc sống công việc tách biệt khỏi đời tư.

definition: tending to doubt what other people tell you; American English spells it skeptical (sceptical about + something)
exampleSentence: I'm very sceptical about what I read in the press.
exampleTranslation: Tôi rất hoài nghi về những gì mình đọc trên báo.

definition: having the training and experience needed to do something well (skilled at + something/-ing)
exampleSentence: She is very skilled at dealing with the public.
exampleTranslation: Cô ấy rất giỏi tiếp xúc với công chúng.

definition: expecting people to obey rules or do what you say (strict with + somebody)
exampleSentence: The Stuarts are very strict with their children.
exampleTranslation: Gia đình Stuart rất nghiêm khắc với con cái.

definition: likely to be affected by something, or having to obey a rule (subject to + something)
translation: có thể bị, phải tuân theo
exampleSentence: All flights are subject to delay.
exampleTranslation: Tất cả các chuyến bay đều có thể bị hoãn.

definition: achieving what you wanted (successful in + something/-ing)
exampleSentence: Were you successful in persuading him to change his mind?
exampleTranslation: Bạn có thành công trong việc thuyết phục anh ấy đổi ý không?

definition: having the right qualities for a particular person or purpose (suitable for + somebody/something)
exampleSentence: The house is not really suitable for a large family.
exampleTranslation: Ngôi nhà này không thực sự phù hợp cho một gia đình đông người.

definition: better, more powerful or more effective than another person or thing (superior to + somebody/something)
exampleSentence: Your computer is far superior to mine.
exampleTranslation: Máy tính của bạn vượt trội hơn máy của tôi nhiều.

definition: caring and feeling sorry about someone's problems (sympathetic towards + somebody)
exampleSentence: The teacher was sympathetic towards the students' difficulties.
exampleTranslation: Giáo viên cảm thông với khó khăn của học sinh.

definition: allowing people to do, say or believe what they want without criticizing them (tolerant of + somebody/something)
exampleSentence: Luckily, my parents were tolerant of my choice of music.
exampleTranslation: May mắn là bố mẹ tôi khoan dung với gu âm nhạc của tôi.

definition: not noticing or realizing what is happening (unaware of + something)
translation: không nhận ra, không biết về
exampleSentence: Mike seems unaware of the trouble he is causing.
exampleTranslation: Mike dường như không nhận ra rắc rối mình đang gây ra.

definition: not having any experience of something (unfamiliar with + something)
exampleSentence: We were unfamiliar with the neighbourhood.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi không quen với khu phố này.

definition: worried or annoyed because you do not like what is happening (unhappy about + something)
exampleSentence: Dennis is unhappy about having to work on a Saturday.
exampleTranslation: Dennis không vui vì phải làm việc vào thứ Bảy.

definition: worried or annoyed because something is not as good as you want (unhappy with + something)
exampleSentence: We were all unhappy with the quality of the service.
exampleTranslation: Tất cả chúng tôi đều không hài lòng với chất lượng dịch vụ.

definition: not certain about something or about what you have to do (unsure about + something)
exampleSentence: If you are unsure about anything, just ask.
exampleTranslation: Nếu bạn không chắc về điều gì, cứ hỏi.

definition: easily harmed or hurt by something (vulnerable to + something)
exampleSentence: Children are most vulnerable to abuse within their own home.
exampleTranslation: Trẻ em dễ bị xâm hại nhất ngay trong chính ngôi nhà của mình.
